name: MMBench-V1.1
intro: MMBench-V1.1 在此限定为英文 v1.1 数据版本。论文 v4/v5 明确将其描述为质量改进后的 3,217 道逻辑题，覆盖 20 个 L3 能力；官方文件按 DEV 1,292 / TEST 1,925 发布。早期 2,974/2,948 计数与中文 v1.1 对应版均作为独立边界。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, National University of Singapore, Zhejiang University
build_method: 三级能力体系、作者冷启动、学生志愿者扩充、纯文本可答与错题双路筛查、人工复核、v1.1 质量修订
metric: CircularEval 逻辑题准确率（总体微平均、L2/L3 分组）
eval_feature: v1.1 版本边界, CircularEval, 启发式与 GPT-4-0125 选项抽取
build_method_en: Three-level taxonomy, author seeds, student-volunteer expansion, text-only and wrong-item screening with human review, and the v1.1 quality revision
eval_feature_en: v1.1 version boundary, CircularEval, heuristic and GPT-4-0125 choice extraction
intro_en: MMBench-V1.1 is bounded here to the English v1.1 dataset. Paper revisions v4/v5 explicitly describe it as a quality-refined set of 3,217 logical questions spanning 20 L3 abilities; official files are released as DEV 1,292 / TEST 1,925. Earlier 2,974/2,948 counts and the aligned Chinese v1.1 sibling remain separate boundaries.
metric_en: CircularEval logical-item accuracy (overall micro-average and L2/L3 groups)

drawio_review_note: The identity is English MMBench v1.1. arXiv revisions v4/v5 explicitly introduce v1.1 as a better-data-quality revision with 3,217 logical items, at least 125 in each of 20 L3 abilities; the audit pins v5 (PDF SHA-256 3cd9025569600c548d29a987e1cef6bdac8dc07cdeb6bd49ef04690ae80ebd6b). Official files contain 1,292 DEV and 1,925 TEST logical items. VLMEvalKit commit 7055d3010c38ccb5dcae1bc9535ca19c7fe5d79f pins MD5 30c05be8f2f347a50be25aa067248184 for DEV and 8d1a704e791df6f5d9fb3ef782b65365 for TEST; commit 0bccf4527f5eb4c2d5837a6492e379f4ca1be63f changed TEST hashes, confirming artifact drift. A 2026-07-21 direct download still had 1,925 logical items but MD5 aab598a927c183aa6657de9097e2be09 and unexpectedly included answer, while the paper says TEST labels are hidden and current evaluation routes test identities to the official server. Therefore label visibility is an audited mutable-release fact, not folded into the paper lifecycle. v1.1 TSVs omit source/comment; circular rows map to one base item via index modulo 1e6. English and Chinese v1.1 files align base IDs, images, categories, splits, and available answers. Evaluation uses zero-shot open generation, heuristic then gpt-4-0125 choice extraction, and all-pass CircularEval; report_acc is a micro mean over logical-item hits overall and within L2/L3. Released judge code can retry three times and then return a random valid choice or Z. Openness is partly public because label/service behavior is version-dependent, source images have mixed provenance, and no dataset-specific image relicense was found. Formal publication evidence [site-a11m-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3005×785 (English) and 3005×785 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3003×783 and 3003×783. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
